---
title: "🗓️ Week 9  -Introduction to LiDAR"
---

Light detection and ranging (LiDAR) is a combination of laser technology and photoelectric detection technology. It uses a laser as a light source to transmit high-frequency laser pulses to the target and a photodetector as a device to receive the returned signal from the target.
